text:
lin: Heads-up: pushed a change to routing policy evaluation that affects quota attribution. SDKs will need to pass the new header for per-route quotas to be accurate. Planning a 2-week opt-in canary.

lin: New header example:
```
X-Redwood-Route: route=ui-lowlatency;tenant=acme
```
Consoles will use this to map tokens -> route buckets. If header missing, attribution falls back to `default-route`.

sarah: Does telemetry sampling still happen at ingest or earlier? Will console show per-route spikes?

tony: Quick question — for Python/TS/Go SDKs do we change defaults or add an opt-in flag?

izzy: Proposal: add opt-in flag `enable_route_header=true` (default false) for 2 weeks, then flip default and post deprecation timeline.

sarah: For canary we should add a dashboard tile 'route attribution (canary)' so teams can spot regressions.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to workspace redwood-dev (us-west) at 1719510200 :rocket:

julian: Reminder: Go SDK needs header-name canonicalization and a fallback for proxies that rewrite casing. Also unit tests for reverse proxies.

tony: I'll open a PR in python-sdk to add header injection on Session level. Plan: env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_HINT` + per-request override.

lin: Also adding `route_hint` to telemetry event schema — need analytics & billing signoff before flipping default.

izzy: For serverless customers detect and log frequent 'missing-route' events so SRE/SEs can help debug.

sarah: UX note: console banner during opt-in with CTA 'Enable route-aware quotas (canary)'. Also link to migration guide.

lin: Tentative timeline: SDK PRs by EOD Wed (1719513600), canary next Tue, default flip after 2 weeks (configurable per-tenant).

tony: ACK. I'll add unit tests + changelog entry and flag in release notes.

lin: Thanks — let's sync in the standup tomorrow if any blockers.
